reason: The original inventory rejected Matplotlib-generated result_images/*-expected image symlinks and therefore skipped independent verification; source_correct=false can mean unavailable rather than an implementation failure.
scope: Apply the same supplemental procedure to every one of the 24 fixed runs, including both arms and both repetitions. No new model requests, source/task changes, test omissions or candidate fixes.
original_report_policy: Keep the original report, booleans, all model failures and request journals unchanged. Report supplemental source assessment as passed, failed or unavailable separately.
snapshot_policy: Hash bounded regular files with O_NOFOLLOW; record raw symlink text without following it; preserve special-file metadata as unsupported.
rebuild_policy: Restore frozen tests/config/dependencies, overlay regular implementation and ordinary files, then reproduce non-protected links as the last host write phase. Link targets are resolved only by the same isolated oracle. Aliases above protected inputs or unsupported special files remain unavailable.
test_policy: Reuse every frozen upstream required test ID and the unchanged oracle; missing/skipped tests cannot pass.
comparison_policy: Separate file-contract compliance, implementation assessment and runtime completion. Do not silently merge original failures with corrected assessments.
freeze_policy: Freeze the supplemental implementation after local safety tests and before its first candidate oracle run; preserve any subsequent revisions separately.
